payload.comparison_rule: COMPOSE runs with prescreen=false. Only the no_prescreen column is a valid comparator. The prescreened column is retained solely to make substitution visible and must never be used as the target.

coverage.sum_is_not_reconstructible: The published no-prescreen column sums to 16.676 over all 23 tasks, but only 7 per-task values are transcribed. A suite-sum comparison is therefore NOT possible from this table.

payload.metric: auc_top10, top_auc(finish=True), 10,000 oracle calls, mean of 3 runs
